zh.title: 民航局無人機與先進空中交通論壇登場 聚焦國際航空安全規範
zh.summary: 民航局舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇，聚焦國際發展與航空安全規範。
body: 交通部民用航空局舉辦的「2026國際無人機及先進空中交通論壇」於11月23日登場，聚焦國際無人機與先進空中交通（AAM）發展，以及國際航空安全規範。
民航局表示，論壇邀請國外民航主管機關與專家分享實務經驗，希望透過交流，讓臺灣無人機產業與制度和國際接軌。
民航局指出，電動垂直起降航空器（eVTOL）等新興技術，未來有機會拓展都市與區域運輸、緊急救援及偏遠地區交通服務。
對於先進空中交通從研發走向實際營運，民航局表示仍須建立適航認證、安全監理及空域整合機制；這也是各國民航主管機關共同面對的課題。

en.title: Taiwan CAA opens forum on drones, advanced air mobility and aviation safety
en.summary: Taiwan CAA opens drone and advanced air mobility forum focused on international development and aviation safety rules.
body: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration opened its 2026 international forum on drones and advanced air mobility on November 23, focusing on international developments in both fields and aviation safety rules.

Foreign civil aviation authorities and experts were invited to share practical experience. The agency said it hopes the exchanges will help Taiwan’s drone industry and institutional framework align with international practices.

The agency said emerging technologies such as electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft, or eVTOLs, could eventually expand urban and regional transport, emergency rescue and transport services in remote areas.

It said moving advanced air mobility from research and development to actual operations still requires mechanisms for airworthiness certification, safety oversight and airspace integration. These are shared challenges for civil aviation authorities in different countries, the agency said.
